description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled in the order of Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, labeled as "Execution Accuracy", with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a category and containing two bars: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL. The NatSQL bars have values of approximately 60.21, 39.64, 32.32, and 51.35 for the Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total categories, respectively. The corresponding TA-SQL bars have values of approximately 63.14, 48.60, 36.11, and 56.19. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across different task complexity levels.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest margin observed in the Moderate category, where TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 compared to NatSQL's 39.64. In the Challenging category, TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11, while NatSQL remains stable at 32.32. Overall, TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels, culminating in a total accuracy of 58.19, which is significantly higher than NatSQL's 51.35.
